summary: Completed backend and frontend verification of the OfficeFlow admin authentication fix. Health, admin login, cookie session, auth/me, public settings, dashboard rendering, and Employees navigation all passed on the external preview.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console logged one warning that wss://officeflow-v3.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws/dispatch closed before connection establishment during dashboard load; core dashboard and navigation remained functional.

action_items: Investigate whether the initial dispatch WebSocket connection should retry after login; no blocking user-facing failure was observed.
seed_data_creation: None; existing seeded Super Admin was used.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Requested health, admin login, public /login redirect, authenticated dashboard, basic content, Employees navigation, and public settings were verified against https://officeflow-v3.preview.emergentagent.com. One non-blocking dispatch WebSocket startup warning appeared in browser console.
rca of the issue: The reported Not Found condition is resolved: the preview /api ingress now reaches the OfficeFlowV3 backend. POST /api/auth/login returns the seeded super_admin user and secure cookies; the frontend then reaches /dashboard and renders dashboard-home without Not Found text.
